description: Central Province Provincial Coucil - Notify the Regulations under Section 47(1) of the Early Childhood Development Charter, No. 03 of 2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily consists of regulations imposed under the Early Childhood Development Charter, detailing the establishment, structure, objectives, membership, and operational procedures for development societies in early childhood development centers. It is a regulatory framework issued by a provincial authority, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While it mentions the Chief Minister's name and portfolios, this is in the context of the regulatory authority issuing the notice, not the primary content of the gazette, which is the regulations themselves.
